decisions.reason: The aloe vera line was launched only in 2023, sits close to the firm's core offer, has its own page, and costs little to keep given in-house small-batch production, so the option is still valuable while demand is uncertain.
The hyaluronic serum is a low-cost extension of the existing facial range with only one year of evidence, so uncertainty has not resolved against it and keeping it is cheap.

The cleansing milk is a staple fitting the established line, cheap to keep with shared ingredients and production, and nothing shows its value has failed, though its brief mention suggests lower prominence.
